book.name: 2 KORINTI
book.title: KORINTI KINA'MI NKISA PORO KAENTIYE (TARA YAGANE)

content: Pigoya, ibaba naeba tigeti iyekana kakagasa pukiye. Wama uma irosakini, ka'waina kamana'wapa otamaginiba mono isa'ama kamana aega'ma, tarawo kakagawo ka tiwamu yiginaba arupu peno.

Piya, paipa tigeti wantopa, wasana agunta punta kinape to ka'isa kinape obina kamanapa urimintone. Piya, tarasa puma wanto ntagaba obina kamana urimintosa puma, naeba to kakema pagasara yuwe. Piya, wama tigeti uma agakanaba, ka aguntaena pukibi ntagara uwaba kampa atakuwe.
We, Karaisiti nae nawamupisa aboramipa kampa napiyewa, a. We, Karaisiti aeba tigeti yogawapa yubu yabuba kampa piye. Aeba tige tikapipa esegi yuga pusu pipa, agaiyo.

Piya, aeba yubu yabu pusu pogini maripo yarapa aeguyuguna, to asintikana Koti nkesegiyenara mintiye. Taeba pabiyama yubu yabu puma miyune. Eya, aeti atokaema mima, aega kaga Koti nkesegiyenara mima, tigetiba yogaba pune.

Tigeba timatiti'enayaga miyebera aya pewe. Pi'na tigupa aegasama agantana agowapa aboraiyo. Piya, Isu Karaisitiba tigupipa mintipa, pi'na nkau'wapa kampa abewa, a. We, timatiti'ena kampa waintisinta aeba tigupipa kampa mintisine.
Pigoya, tigeba taepa tagama taeka: Igeba mono ki'isa kampa paga pawe, usanaga nabugaye.

Pigoya, Kotiba kabiritakiri ataenaba kampa aboranema, nunamuba otamagita miyune. Taepa tagaigita, mono'ama nkau'wantaga'ena aborawe, usanagaba kampa yune. Kampaye. We, wasanami nkiyobi taeba paga pasu pompepa, aerawane. Tigeba arupuyenama nkau'wantaga'ena penoma, ka'antoga nunamu yune.
Eya, taeba tagantana akayukena wanane. Taeba tagantana mana pukena pune.
Piya, taeba yubu yabuba puma miyokiri, tigeba esegiyenayaga miyepa pikaba tantawamaba aogi piye. Piya, tigupa esegima anosanema, Wa'egamapa nunamu otaune.

Piya, naeba tigeti wama tiki nakiyena puritasanaga maru'ena pagasarasa obina kamana kaema timuwe. Piya, Wa'egawamaba esegiyena naminti pipa akasabakasasa puma tiyeba'marakena wanane. Uwa kiyesa puma imatiti'ena esegima anosanema, namintine.

We nao'mitaba, kamana'nepa uma mayama nagari yuwe: Tigeba aogi tintabarima miyiyo. Piya, obina kamana'nepa abintiri, tigupa maema aewarama miyiyo. Tigeba ka tintabarima paruyenabi mpiyiyo. Piya pukubepa, Koti aeba agu kao'enamape paruyenamape agowamaba tigege miwaema miyeno.
A'ya'ma mono kinapa tiyapa imima aogima tiyo'ena piyo.
A'ya'ma matasa Kotiti atokaeya kina'miba: Aya pewe, yewe.
Pigoya, Wa'ega Isu Karaisiti nkawagaenawampage, Koti nkagu kao'enawampage, Aota Awamusa'ama ka tintabariritama atokaeritakenaenabe, a'ya'ma tigeti waima waiyeno.
